findings.scenario: A contribution scope filter or external adapter throws during qualification. The catch records stage eligibility with outcome error. Trace::finish (Trace.php:91) then appends filter/skipped because no step uses stage filter. The same backfill happens when BoundaryStage.php:130 records a throwing common() filter as stage boundary.
findings.impact: explain shows the canonical filter stage as skipped after the filter failed. A stage-keyed reader treats the failure as a stage that did not run. The error step is stored under eligibility or boundary, which finish() does not treat as the filter stage.
findings.required_fix: Record that failure on stage filter with outcome error, including the exception class and message. Do not also synthesize filter/skipped. Apply the same stage name when the common-boundary filter throws.

findings.scenario: A qualified Grants candidate, or any PolicyOnly candidate, reaches MembershipRestriction::check and the check returns pass (subject is a member, or the adapter allows). denied() is false, so no membership step is written. finish() then appends membership/skipped. The check is not called only when the candidate is unqualified and the mode is not Policy.
findings.impact: An allow or policy explanation reports a membership check that ran and passed as not executed.
findings.required_fix: When check() is invoked and returns pass, record membership with outcome pass. Leave the stage absent only when the check is not invoked, so finish() can mark that case skipped.

limitations: Read-only inspection; tests were not executed.
The other 36 scope paths were not re-read; final scope.json hashes match the previously inspected candidate.
Laravel's Response class is not in the snapshot; status and code preservation was checked through Decision, GateBridge::toGateResult, and GateResponseTest.
Trait, facade, and azguard.can remain future owners and were not reviewed.
